reviews.t: One of the BEST on the market!
reviews.x: This is a wonderful bath brush.  Very durable, I've posted photos of exactly how "thick" this is compared to my last brush.  The bristles are soft yet durable, the handle is well made, THICK will last!  As you can see from my photos, my prior brush (6 months old) was really quite thin, ready to "crack at any moment".  The massage side is on a soft/sponge-y base so your massage is very comfortable and not overly course.  The wood is coated well so over time it will not cause splin

Well made.  Though I know that this is subjective, the bristle stiffness is perfect to my needs:  not so stiff that they feel like they're scraping off your skin but firm enough to give and invigorated, clean feel.  Nice solid handle

I bought this for my husband whose back is frequently itchy. He uses this brush at least once a day and he just loves it! The brush is just the right stiffness. He says the massager side doesn't do anything for him, but that's OK, I bought it for the brush side.

reviews.t: I'm very disappointed, waste of money
reviews.x: I used it only for a month and it became moldy! Wood supposed to be covered with special protective coating! I'm very disappointed, waste of money.

Excellent scrubber. Nice bristle action on skin. Reaches all those hard to get places on back. I am 6' 2". So that length works well. I have had no bristle fall out nor unpleasant aroma, despite the manufacturer's precautions.  I shake it about three times after daily usage and it gets the remaining excess water out and dries without mold. It helps to clean your bathing area with vinegar as mold, mildew hate that.

I have tried a lot of bath brushes, and this one's the best. Unlike other reviewers, I don't want one that will scratch all of my skin off when I use it; rather, I like a brush that does its job but is moderately soft. The side of the brush that's good for massage doesn't really work for me except on my feet, and it's awesome for that.

This is the best bath brush I ever owned. I've tried a few others but honestly everything about this one is exactly as the description states. The bristles are soft to your skin, not like others that can be harsh. The flip side is a massage and it does the job just fine. I'm very picky with what I buy, you won't be disappointed.
The bristles will rip the skin right off your back, so only buy this brush if you are a masochist.  I completely wasted my money.

reviews.t: perfect balance between soft and stiff
reviews.x: I have tried many of these brushes in the past.  Most of the time I end up tossing them because they break very quickly, are super soft or super rough.  This is the first one I have tried that I actually like.  The bumpy side doesn't do anything for me but it may for someone else.  The brush side is amazing.  It can be used with soap or body wash very easily.  It lathers up nice and keeps the lather.  It allows me to reach the spots on my back that I just can't get to.  It is exactly the right t

This a great body brush.  The bristles are just firm enough to exfoliate, but too much to feel scratchy. Love the little wooden pegs on the opposite side.  Add a little soap to them and it's like a mini massage on my legs.  Great to increase circulation.  I also appreciate that I can hang it up in the shower.  I got a large suction cup hook for my shower.  Works great!!!

At first I thought I liked it because it felt good on my back. After a couple of weeks it's all black mold growing next to the bristles next to the base. I went and got a cheap plastic one that seems like it won't grow mold.

reviews.t: Don't give this product the brush off.
reviews.x: Nice quality.  The bristles are dense. The handle is solid - good balance.  The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because the handle should've been a couple inches longer.

reviews.t: Long and strong  handle makes it easy to use
reviews.x: I like how my skin feels after I exfoliate. This brush handle is made of bamboo and is very strong. No worries of the handle breaking.  The bristles are firm, yet compliant in bend on the skin without irritation. I like the bristle side of the brush and, with the long handle, you can easily reach any hard to get to location. I am a little puzzled as to the benefits of the wood bead side. I did not feel like it did any good at all, but the bristle side worked very well for exfoliating your skin.

So far so good.  I've only owned this bath brush for a couple of weeks, but it's hold up well thus far.  The wood beads don't feel like they are actually made of wood (although I might be mistaken) and the entire "massage" side of it seems kind of odd/useless to me, but that's not what I bought it for anyway so it's not a big deal.  The one notable thing I can think of to mention is that, out of the box, the bristles are quite stiff and coarse.  If you just get the brush wet and try to u

reviews.t: no amount of scrubbing removes the black from the bristles ...
reviews.x: no amount of scrubbing removes the black from the bristles have turned black so i'm no longer using this product. In addition, the handle was really too big and heavy for me.

reviews.t: serves for what I bought it
reviews.x: I use only a soft side of it. Do not see how the other side would be useful to me. The reach is good and the quality does not diminish with time.

reviews.t: This product will mold after use!
reviews.x: I initially have this 5 stars, but after having it for less than 3 weeks, it's molded! Will not purchase again.

reviews.t: Excellent material and build, but not quite what I was looking for.
reviews.x: The brush handle is too thick for me to easily grasp and manipulate. Additionally, I prefer a longer handle to better reach all areas of my back. These are personal preferences, but significant enough for me to continue shopping for another back brush. The rubber knobs don't provide service to me.  The quality of materials and contruction are excellent. Natural bore bristles are comfortable, scrub well, and I appreciate. Purchase and delivery via Amazon was, as usual, a pleasureable experience.

reviews.t: Bamboo just does not mold like other scrubbers
reviews.x: Bamboo just does not mold like other scrubbers!  Plus it is easier to hold - very smooth.  The bristles are well placed and well anchored.  You can use this for wet or drive bushing.  The rubber tips are fantastic to loosen up muscles, tendons and increase circulation.  Use a great oil when you use the rubber tips for circulation. Nice!

I like the brush, but the tip has split after just a few months of very light use.  I would assume the brush is built to withstand moisture since it's a bath brush.  I do like the fact it is made from bamboo.
I love this brush. The bristles are very nice. They're boar bristles, as I remember. I haven't used the nub side so much, though I know it's for massaging.
I'm satisfied with the brush, but the product explanation on the box was very wierd, i.e., the product's TASTE would improve with use.
My husband loves this. He always had a hard time getting his back when washing. This solved the problem. It is made very well.
This has made my daily bathing routine much easier as my range of motion has become quite limited due to arthritis.
I ended up not using it, I couldn't get beyond the brush smelling like a barnyard.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the bristles as well-balanced—firm enough to exfoliate but not scratchy or harsh.
Many customers describe the brush as well made and durable, with a solid handle.
Several reviewers report mold or black discoloration developing on the brush after a short time.
The massage/bead side is often described as useless or doing nothing for the user.
A few reviewers find the bristles too stiff and harsh on the skin.
